coordinator.role: Tech Fleet member and former project coordinator

opportunities.title: Join a community onboarding call
opportunities.description: A free online call for new members, run by the Tech Fleet community.
opportunities.expected: Join one call on Google Meet to hear from alumni, learn how Tech Fleet works and ask your questions. Upcoming calls are listed on the community calendar.
opportunities.requirements: Register for a call on the community calendar.

opportunities.title: Observe a project team
opportunities.description: Watch a real Tech Fleet project team at work, without applying.
opportunities.expected: Pick any meeting on the open project calendar and sit in as an observer. You don't do project tasks. Tech Fleet suggests this before you apply to a team.
opportunities.requirements: Get the Projects and Observers roles in Tech Fleet's Discord.

opportunities.title: Read the handbooks and core courses
opportunities.description: Free, self-paced reading about how Tech Fleet teams work.
opportunities.expected: Work through the user guide handbooks and the platform's core courses at your own pace to build an agile mindset.

opportunities.title: Take a masterclass
opportunities.description: Short, practical classes on teamwork and leadership.
opportunities.expected: Register for a masterclass, such as Service Leadership, and practice the skills with other members. Service Leadership is free. Other masterclasses cost about $50 to $100.
opportunities.requirements: Join the Tech Fleet platform and get the Masterclasses role in Discord.

opportunities.title: Join a community volunteer team
opportunities.description: Help run Tech Fleet itself on a volunteer team.
opportunities.expected: Apply for a volunteer role and join a team that supports the community. Time depends on the role, usually for about 3 months, and you set your own schedule.
opportunities.requirements: Apply for a role. Volunteers are asked to be responsive and consistent.

opportunities.title: Train on a nonprofit project team
opportunities.description: Train on an agile team building something for a real nonprofit client.
opportunities.expected: Work for 8 weeks on a cross-functional team with a nonprofit client, guided by coaches. Tech Fleet expects 15 to 20 hours a week. The training is free.
opportunities.requirements: Apply. Observe a team and take the Service Leadership Masterclass first. A bootcamp, certificate, school or self-study background is expected.
